questions_json.explanation: Conscientiousness describes organized, responsible, self-disciplined people who plan ahead and follow through.
questions_json.q: Sara plans her week in advance, keeps her notes color-coded, and always submits assignments before the deadline. Which Big Five trait does she score high on?

questions_json.explanation: Freud's ego works on the reality principle, finding realistic ways to satisfy the id's desires within the superego's moral limits.
options: The id, because it seeks immediate pleasure
The ego, because it balances desire with reality
The superego, because it only follows morals
The unconscious, because it hides memories
questions_json.q: Ahmed wants to eat the last slice of cake, but his conscience says sharing is good, so he splits it with his sister. Which part of personality made this balanced decision?

questions_json.explanation: Neuroticism reflects emotional instability - anxiety, moodiness, and being easily upset - the opposite of emotional stability.
questions_json.q: Usman worries constantly, gets upset over small problems, and feels tense most days. Which Big Five trait is highest in Usman?

questions_json.explanation: Agreeableness describes kind, cooperative, trusting people who forgive easily and value harmony over conflict.
